title: Issi son of Rav Yitzchak son of Rav Yehudah bar Yechezkel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned only in Yevamot 64b: his daughter Chuma married Rachava of Pumbedita, who died; she then married Rav Yitzchak, son of Rabbah bar Bar Chana, who died; she then married Abaye.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Yevamot 64b explicitly calls Huma Issi’s daughter and gives the succession Rachava of Pumbedita, Rav Yitzchak son of Rabbah bar bar Chana, then Abaye. The notice stops after the last marriage; no further event is added.

Yevamot 64b supplies the named daughter and succession of husbands. Hyman’s final bar Yechezkel patronymic and the point where his notice ends are retained; no later event from the longer passage is added.
